parse_response: parse a model response string into a list of (city, stay_days) tuples for trip planning
compute_example_score: compute exact-match accuracy for a single trip planning example against ground truth
compute_score: compute sample-level exact-match accuracy across multiple trip planning responses
run_evaluate_trip_planning: run the trip planning evaluation script with a JSON data file via argparse CLI
review_parse_response: review the parse_response function that extracts city and day information from model output
